Intentional accessibility upgrade: when onCountryClick is passed, the country area is a real <button type="button"> (keyboard reachable, named 'Select country (IN +91)') instead of a clickable <div>. data-testid, onCountryClick, countryFlag and className behaviour are unchanged. One behavioural difference: a disabled v2 PhoneInput no longer fires onCountryClick (v1 fired it).

test: text-field :: renders default size with addons (container path)
reason: Finds the addon container with the v1 utility class .h-[42px]; v2's sizes differ by design. Same DOM, same behaviour.

test: text-field :: uses container with focus-within styling when has addons
reason: Queries the v1 class .focus-within:border-semantic-border-input-focus; v2 uses its own focus tokens. Same DOM, same behaviour.

test: spinner :: Spinner SVG structure track circle has 0.25 opacity
reason: Arc-parity redesign: the spinner is now a single 270-degree ring with no faint track, so the v1 assertion on the track circle's opacity no longer applies. Role, label, sizes and props are unchanged; a hidden second circle keeps the v1 element structure.

test: spinner :: Spinner SVG structure active arc has strokeLinecap round

test: bouncing-loader :: BouncingLoader applies the self-contained wave animation with staggered per-dot delay
reason: Arc-parity redesign: the typing-dots cycle is 1.2s with a 0.16s stagger instead of 0.2s. Still staggered per dot; only the timing value differs.

test: checkbox :: Checkbox renders no icon when unchecked
reason: Arc-parity redesign: the check mark is always mounted so it can draw in and out; it is invisible (fill scale 0.6, dash fully offset) when unchecked. Role, aria-checked and callbacks are unchanged.

test: date-range-picker :: DateRangePicker renders weekday headers in uppercase
reason: Arc-parity redesign: weekday headers are two-letter title case ('Su', 'Mo') instead of 'SU', 'MO'. Same column order and count.

Intentional accessibility change in the Arc-parity pass: the clear button is now keyboard-reachable (tabindex 0) while it is visible, instead of tabindex -1. Label, type, click behaviour and the focus return to the input are unchanged.

Intentional accessibility change in the keyboard pass: the chip remove crosses are pointer-only (tabindex -1) and the chips sit in an aria-hidden group, because a button nested in the trigger button cannot be reached by keyboard or assistive tech. role="button" and aria-label="Remove <label>" are unchanged, so getByLabelText and click handlers keep working. Keyboard users drop the last pick with Backspace/Delete on the trigger or toggle rows in the list, and the picks are read out as text. getByRole('button', { name: 'Remove …' }) no longer finds them, because they are aria-hidden.

Intentional accessibility change in the keyboard pass: Clear all is a real <button type="button" aria-label="Clear all"> beside the trigger instead of a span[role=button] nested inside it. Label, click behaviour, showClearAll and the disabled guard are unchanged; it is reached by Tab right after the trigger.

Intentional: the field is integer-only (a decimal point is refused, where v1 silently floored it), so the on-screen keyboard is numeric instead of decimal. type=number, min, max, step, value and aria-label on the input are unchanged.

Intentional accessibility change: without incrementAriaLabel / decrementAriaLabel the stepper buttons are named after the field ("Increase Delay hours") instead of reading "Increase value" on every field of a form. Passing the labels explicitly (as the v1 tests and BotFollowUps do) keeps the exact text; pass "Increase value" / "Decrease value" to restore the old default.
